title: Built, shipped, written up
sub: A selection of things I've built across AI, backend, and research — each one owned end-to-end, from idea to working system.

items.title: AI System Project One
items.desc: An end-to-end AI/retrieval system — ingestion, retrieval, serving, and evaluation. Owned the full pipeline and the backend infrastructure behind it, then benchmarked it properly.
items.tech: Python · PyTorch · FastAPI · Vector DB · Docker

items.title: Backend System Project Two
items.desc: A production backend — APIs, a data pipeline, and the reliability work to keep it upright under load. Focused on latency, throughput, and observability.

items.title: Research Project Three
items.desc: An applied research project implementing a method from first principles, evaluating it rigorously, and writing it up — the basis for a publication (see Publications).

items.title: Evaluation Harness Project Four
items.desc: A benchmarking harness for retrieval systems — reproducible evals, regression detection, and a dashboard for tracking metrics across runs.

items.title: Data Pipeline Project Five
items.desc: A streaming data pipeline ingesting, transforming, and serving features for ML models in near real-time.

items.title: Model Serving Project Six
items.desc: A low-latency model server with batching, caching, and graceful degradation under load.
